valve-v-a.collet_clock_basis: Movable inlet release collet rotated about native +Y through the port-centre axis. The shared measured reference supplies the complete collet; the fixed body, posts, ports and nominal stem engagement retain their selected datums.

vb_mount.attachment: Integral upright seat wall with a fixed west backing plane joining the existing WAGO wells
vb_mount.scope: Integral production lid stock; nominal native geometry. Installed retention remains physically unqualified.

metrics.tube_centerlines: Continuous R14 inlet tube and concealed axial outlet join

soda_route.flow: Cold-core soda guide → continuous tube through accepted R14 holder → meter → concealed tube join → nested rear stems → soda bulkhead

upstream_handoff.scope: The plain guide is an ownership boundary in one continuous tube. It adds no cut, socket or insertion; the core internal span and external rise meet at this plane.

soda_route.scope: Continuous supported insulated inlet with an estimated15.7mm meter insertion. The plain guide adds no joint or cut. The rear concealed join and19.2958mm return stem retain their selected datums. Physical receiving depth, sealing and retention are unqualified.

fore_routes.hardware_scope: V-A stays low; V-B feeds Y-B through its return above the PCB. The meter has fore/aft ports and an east-facing label. The meter, directly seated inlet stem and vertical inlet span belong to the cold core; the nested rear stems and concealed outlet span belong to back-top.
fore_routes.insertion_scope: Family-based layout estimates. Drain outlet stem retains3.3058 mm exposure for the cradle; the soda rear return retains2.4048 mm. Physical fully seated marks govern fitting cuts.

ASSE, Pisco and meter slide seats and caps

rear_wall.scope: Production rear-wall and sidewall datums; named relief retains the fluid clamping section.

c14.body_opening_basis: Measured IEC C14 wiring-side body profile with 0.25 mm clearance; distinct from the outboard flange recess and generic panel-cutout recommendation.

keystone.receptacle: Existing RiteAV lip, pocket, insertion ease and snap catches; no decorative trim

rear_wall.side_walls: Integral relay bosses and valve seats from the shared native part frames.

soda_inlet.selection: Continuous R14 inlet beneath the rear meter, on the soda union axis

foam.occupied_model_scope: One square-cut piece of owned foam compresses around the holder and locally against the four accepted neighboring bodies and the two V-K lead exits. Native display subtraction estimates occupied space; it is not a shaped cut pattern, measured strain, fit tolerance or thermal result.

soda_inlet.assembly: Slide the foam over the tube and accepted bend holder, insert the tube into the meter, load the meter seat forward and slide aft onto the soda union stub, then fit the west snap cap.
